name: roombridge
description: RoomBridge: remote CAD expertise sharing between a LiDAR iPhone, Blender and family browsers.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && python3 -m unittest discover -s blender_addon/tests -t blender_addon
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
